title: Model onboarding governance playbook: enterprise pinning, deprecation windows, and eval gates
creator: Amit Patel
description: Create a prescriptive playbook and automation checklist for model onboarding and lifecycle governance aimed at enterprise customers. The playbook must cover: intake form fields, priority scoring, version pinning requests, deprecation notification windows, automated and manual eval gates (quality/regression/latency), security and compliance signoffs, and rollout/rollback runbooks. Work includes spec for UX in the Console intake flow, API contract changes for pinning, and a lightweight audit trail for enterprise audits.
acceptance_criteria: Publicly available onboarding playbook doc linked from the Console intake flow
Intake form fields specified and wireframes reviewed by Design and Eng
Priority scoring rubric that produces a numeric score and recommended SLA tier
Version pinning API defined and implementation plan accepted by infra team
Deprecation policy defined: minimum 90-day notice for GA models, 30-day for beta, with automated customer notifications
Eval gate thresholds documented (perplexity/ROUGE/embedding drift/latency regression) and linked to eval dashboard
Security/compliance checklist captured and labeled for mandatory signoff
Canary rollout + automatic fallback strategy defined for model swaps
Audit log schema for onboarding actions and decisions is specified
tasks: Draft intake form schema and POST contract for Console API
Design Console UX mockups for model onboarding and pinning flow
Collaborate with Research to define automated evals and thresholds
Work with Eng (runtime + infra) to spec pin/unpin implementation and data retention
Write deprecation email templates and automate notification cadence
Create runbooks for canary rollouts and emergency rollbacks
Coordinate security review and KMS/HSM requirements for Private customers
